blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) aims to recognize novel combinations of previously observed objects and attributes. Prior work showed that large-scale vision-language models encode decomposable semantic structures that can be recomposed to enable generalization. The Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) framework formalizes this by identifying directions in the tangent space at the Frechet mean of the embedding distribution, which encode primitive visual concepts. Unseen attribute-object compositions can be synthesized through vector addition of these primitives. We revisit the assumption that compositional generalization requires explicit attribute-object pair re-composition. By means of new compositional scoring functions and extensive evaluations, we show that directly using the decomposed primitives suffices for recognizing unseen compositions. In that, we gain insights on how the geometry of the embedding manifold (Euclidean, spherical, or hyperbolic) and dataset structure affect compositional reasoning. Across models (CLIP, DINOv2, MERU, HyCoCLIP), we show that compositional structure consistently emerges as primitive representations, enabling inference on CZSL benchmarks (MIT-States, VAW-CZSL, UT-Zappos50K, Clothing16K) and group robustness on Waterbirds and CelebA. Code: https://github.com/nis-research/Compositionality-with-Primitives.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recognizing a sliced banana after seeing only sliced bread and whole bananas requires disentangling the attributes sliced and whole from the
objects bread and banana , and reasoning over them independently.
This ability reflects the broader principle of compositionality, a fundamental cognitive skill of humans clearly arising in language [ 14 ] , whereby complex concepts are constructed from simpler, reusable ones [ 24 ] . At its core, it underpins the ability to generalize robustly to novel compositions without requiring direct supervision [ 14 ] .

在只看到切片面包和整块香蕉后认清一个切片的香蕉,需要将切片和整块的属性从中分离出来。

这种能力反映了构成性这一更广泛的原则,即人类在语言[14]中明确产生的一种基本认知技能,即从更简单、可重复使用的概念中构建复杂的概念[24]。 其核心是,它巩固了在不需要直接监督的情况下,对新组成作有力概括的能力。

blocks.en:
In Machine Vision, this paradigm is formalized as compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) [ 20 , 21 ] : given training images depicting a closed set of attribute-object pairs, the aim is to enable a model to recognize novel compositions of known concepts without having seen them during training. Open-world CZSL [ 18 ] extended this setting to the full Cartesian product of attributes and objects, significantly increasing task
difficulty, and accounting for the long-tailed distribution of real-world generalization.
Existing solutions typically attempt to learn compositional representations using conditional formulations of attribute-object representations [ 36 , 9 , 35 ] , or learning compositional soft-prompt [ 22 , 17 ] , visual proxies [ 41 ] or invariant representations [ 42 ] .
blocks.zh:
在Machine Vision中,这个范式被形式化为组成式的零射学习(CZSL)[20,21]:给定了描绘一组封闭的属性-对象对的训练图像,目的是使一个模型能够识别已知概念的新组成,而在训练期间没有看到过. Open-world CZSL [18] 将这个设置扩展为属性和对象的全笛卡尔产品, 任务大大增加
难度,并计入现实世界通化的长尾分布.
现有解决方案通常尝试使用属性-对象表达[36,9,35]的有条件配体,或学习成分软速态[22,17],视觉代词[41]或不常态表达[42]来学习成分表达.

blocks.en:
Recent work on Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings
(GDE) [ 2 ] provides a different perspective: vision embeddings of pre-trained vision-language models already exhibit compositional semantic structures. These can be disentangled to perform compositional zero-shot classification. By projecting representations into the tangent space at the Fréchet mean of the embedding distribution of a dataset and performing a factorization step,
attribute and object representations emerge as vector directions that embed basic visual concepts, called primitives. These can be recombined by vector arithmetics in the tangent space, thus synthesizing the representation of unseen object-attribute pairs and enabling their recognition.
However, the focus in [ 2 ] was limited to
CLIP spherical embeddings [ 28 ] . It remains unclear whether this view of compositionality extends to other space geometries, i.e. spaces with flat (Euclidean) or negative (hyperbolic) curvature, and whether explicit composition of primitives into pairs is necessary to achieve open-world compositional generalization. This question gains particular relevance for hyperbolic models [ 5 , 23 ] , where embeddings lie on the Lorentz space and representations encode compositional hierarchy in a tree-like fashion.

In this work, we place primitives at the center of the analysis and revisit compositional reasoning in VLMs. By means of novel compositional scoring functions, we demonstrate that primitives can be used directly to perform compositional inference without the need of explicitly constructing (unseen) pair representations. We demonstrate improved open-world compositional generalization,
across Euclidean, spherical, and hyperbolic representation
spaces, which hold different geometric and data distribution properties (see Figure 1 ).
To perform this extensive investigation, we build upon the GDE framework and leverage its formulation beyond the original spherical setting of CLIP [ 28 ] ,

blocks.en: We also develop a formulation of primitives directly on the embedding manifold as the Fréchet means of samples sharing an attribute or object, and call them intrinsic primitives . We thus study manifold-native primitives as well as tangent-space GDE primitives, investigating how latent space geometry influences compositional abilities of models.

blocks.en:
Across experiments, we find that compositional structure is a general emergent property of pre-trained models, showing through both GDE and intrinsic primitive representations across several CZSL benchmarks (MIT-States, VAW-CZSL,
Clothing16K, UT-Zappos50K), with stronger evidence for datasets that contain samples with higher semantic variance. We further show that primitive-based inference is beneficial for improving recognition under group bias in the data through experiments on benchmark datasets for group robustness (Waterbirds, CelebA) using solely the object primitives, decoupled from the attribute primitives.
The observed substantial and consistent increase of worst group accuracy indicates that
biases and spurious correlations induced by attributes can be removed with primitive-based reasoning.
The contributions of this work are therefore summarized as: (i) Primitives as the basis for open-world compositional learning and generalization. We show that pretrained models consistently organize representation into primitives, either as tangent-space directions or intrinsic points on manifolds, which encode basic visual concepts of attributes and objects. We develop new compositional scoring functions and demonstrate with extensive experiments that primitives support direct CZSL inference and open-world generalization, making explicit attribute-object pair construction unnecessary. (ii) Understanding of compositional power of pretrained models in relation to manifold geometry and dataset intrinsic variance. We find that, while compositional structure is geometry-agnostic, its task-wise optimal representation depends on the underlying geometry: tangent-space primitives are sufficient in Euclidean and spherical spaces, whereas hyperbolic representations benefit from intrinsic primitives aligned with their space geometry. We further shed light on the role that CZSL datasets and their intrinsic variance have in factorizing compositional primitives in pretrained models.

服装16K,UT-Zappos50K),对含有语义差异较大的样本的数据集有较强的证据. 我们进一步表明,基于原始的推论有利于在群体偏差下,通过仅使用对象原始物,与属性原始物脱钩的团体强性基准数据集实验(Waterbirds, CelebA),提高数据的识别.

因此,这项工作的贡献归纳为:(一) 以基础作为开放世界的构成学习和概括的基础。 我们显示,经过预先训练的模型总是把表现组织成原始的, 无论是作为直接的空间方向,还是作为多元性的内在点, 它将属性和物体的基本视觉概念编码。 我们开发了新的组成分数函数,并用广泛的实验演示原始人支持直接的CZSL推论和开放世界的泛化,使得明确的属性-对象对构造没有必要. (二) 了解预先训练的模型在多几何和数据集内在差异方面的组成力。 我们发现,虽然组成结构是几何-不可知的,但其任务上的最佳表现取决于基本的几何:在欧几里得和球形空间中,正交-空间原始物已经足够了,而双曲表示物则得益于与其空间几何学一致的内在原始物. 我们进一步阐明了CZSL数据集的作用及其在预先训练的模型中将组成原始物因素化的内在差异。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Compositional zero-shot learning in VLMs. Early compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) methods modeled attribute-object relations through shared embedding
spaces [ 10 , 38 ] .
More recent studies have shifted attention to the compositional properties of Vision-Language models and highlighted that contrastive VLMs inherently struggle with text-based composition during standard inference, often behaving as a “bag of words” [ 34 , 39 ] .
This vulnerability is further underscored by benchmarks like SugarCrepe [ 8 ] , which demonstrate that VLMs frequently rely on statistical hacks rather than genuine compositionality.
In order to improve the compositional reasoning abilities of VLMs, subsequent research has explored adaptation strategies based on soft-prompt tuning [ 22 , 17 ] , or learning conditional attribute-object representations, where attribute frequency is coupled with the most likely co-occurring objects [ 36 , 9 , 35 ] .

较近期的研究将注意力转移到了Vision-Language模型的构成属性上,并强调了对比性的VLM在标准推论中与基于文本的构成存在内在的纠缠,经常表现为"词包"[34,39].
诸如SugarCrepe[8]之类的基准进一步强调了这种脆弱性,这些基准表明,VLM经常依赖统计黑客而不是真正的组成。
为了提高VLM的构成推理能力,随后的研究探索了基于软速调[22,17]的适应策略,或者学习有条件的属性-对象表示,其中属性频率与最可能共发生对象[36,9,35].

In [ 2 ] , it was hypothesised that the pre-trained vision encoder of VLMs natively encodes compositional structures, induced by language-based pre-training. Thus, Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) was proposed to factorize primitive representation directions in the tangent space at the Fréchet mean of the
embeddings distribution,
enabling training-free compositional reasoning via constructing unseen combination of primitives. The focus was restricted to spherical (CLIP-like) embeddings and to explicit construction of object-attribute pair representations for CZSL.

blocks.en:
In this work, we fundamentally revisit the assumption that explicit pair re-composition is necessary for CZSL inference. We formulate new scoring functions for compositional classification that operate directly on independent object and attribute primitives. We show that leveraging these primitive representations is sufficient to
recognize unseen compositions, bypassing pair recombination entirely. Furthermore, we expand the GDE framework to work across different geometries of the latent space (i.e. Euclidean, spherical and hyperbolic) and demonstrate the emergence of compositional structures in a broad family of visual encoders.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们从根本上重新审视了一种假设,即明确的对子重构对CZSL推论是必要的. 我们为组成分类制定了新的评分功能,这些功能直接运行在独立的物体和属性原始物上. 我们显示,利用这些原始的表述就足以
识别无形的构成,绕过对重组合。 此外,我们扩大了GDE框架,以在潜在空间(即欧几里得、球形和双曲线)的不同几何面体之间开展工作,并展示在视觉编码器的广泛家族中,组成结构的出现。

blocks.en:
Our work differs from fine-tuning [ 22 , 17 ] and conditional attribute learning [ 36 , 9 , 35 ] , as we do not add learnable components and study the embedding capabilities of pretrained VLMs.
It also shares a philosophical connection with Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) [ 13 ] , which enforce intermediate, primitive-based concept representations for downstream inference. However, while CBMs require explicit bottleneck layers or fine-tuning with concept supervision, we analyze the compositional structure that inherently emerges within the embedding space of pretrained models.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作与微调[22,17]和有条件的属性学习[36,9,35]不同,因为我们没有添加可学习的组件,也没有研究预先训练的VLM的嵌入能力.
它还与Concept Bottleneck Models (CFM) [13] 有着哲学上的联系,它强制进行中间的,原始的概念表述,用于下游推论. 然而,虽然建立信任措施需要明确的瓶颈层或与概念监督进行微调,但我们分析了在预先训练的模型嵌入空间内固有的组成结构。

blocks.en:
Compositionality in hyperbolic VLMs. Most vision-language models operate on the unit hypersphere using cosine
similarity.
In contrast, hyperbolic models
embed representations on the Lorentz model [ 23 , 5 , 29 , 27 , 37 ] , where radius reflects semantic specificity, and geometry captures hierarchical structure: abstract concepts are placed closer to the origin, while more complex detailed concepts lie further away.
HyCoCLIP [ 23 ] further incorporates
compositional entailment supervision to align scene-object
compositions with the hierarchical organization of the embedding space.
While prior work has primarily focused on retrieval, entailment, and hierarchy preservation, we instead investigate how hyperbolic geometry shapes compositional reasoning.
We show that primitives naturally align with the manifold structure, and that for group robustness intrinsic primitives provide a more semantically-coherent representation than tangent-space approximations in hyperbolic settings.

blocks.en:
Compositionality in vision-only DINO. Compositional capabilities are not exclusive to cross-modal vision-language models. Self-supervised vision-only foundation models, such as DINOv2 [ 19 ] , capture exceptional fine-grained, localized spatial semantics without using any language-signal during training. Recent efforts have explored post-hoc mechanisms to
interface language with these frozen visual encoders. For instance, Talk2DINO [ 1 ] demonstrated that text embeddings can be aligned, via a learned projection, onto DINO patch-level features to guide open-vocabulary tasks.
These findings suggest that a structured semantic organization emerges within the token embeddings of vision-only pre-trained encoders.
Understanding the geometry underlying this intrinsic compositionality is therefore crucial, as such models provide powerful representations that are not influenced by language biases.
In this work, we apply the GDE framework to DINOv2 and show that compositional structure naturally emerges in its (Euclidean) latent space, despite the absence of language supervision.
blocks.zh:
组成能力不仅限于跨模式的视觉语言模型。 自我监督的唯视基础模型,如DINOv2[19],捕捉出类拔萃的精细,局部的空间语义,在训练时不使用任何语言符号. 最近的努力探索了冲突后机制。

这些调查结果表明,一个结构化的语义组织在仅以视觉为主的事先训练的编码器的象征内出现。
因此,理解这种内在构成性背后的几何特征至关重要,因为这种模型提供了不受语言偏差影响的有力表述。
在这项工作中,我们将GDE框架应用于DINOv2,并表明尽管没有语言监督,其(Euclidean)潜伏空间中自然会出现组成结构.

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: In this section, we provide a brief overview of the mathematical background relevant to the notion of compositional embeddings and the GDE framework. Moreover, we provide the formalization of open-world CZSL and pair-based scoring functions used for recognition, and cover the foundational alignment of DINOv2 patch embeddings with text embeddings of CLIP done via the Talk2DINO framework.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们简要概述了与组成嵌入概念和GDE框架有关的数学背景。 此外,我们提供用于识别的开放世界CZSL和对等的评分函数的正规化,并涵盖DINov2补丁嵌入与通过Talk2DINO框架完成的CLIP嵌入文本的基调一致。

blocks.en: 4 Primitive-based CZSL
blocks.zh: 4 初级CZSL

blocks.en:
The core focus of this work is the representation of visual concept as primitives (i.e. isolated attributes and objects representations), that form fundamental building blocks of compositional generalization. Rather than evaluating compositionality via pre-defined textual or visual pairs, we investigate how individual primitives emerge within different manifold geometries.
Specifically, we study two distinct approaches for extracting these representations: intrinsic primitives computed directly on the underlying manifold via Riemannian operations, and tangent primitives extracted as localized linear vector directions via the Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) framework. Under both paradigms, inference is performed zero-shot by scoring test images directly against these standalone primitives in their native mathematical domains. This eliminates the need for explicit primitive re-composition, currently used as standard in GDE. Figure 2 illustrates the differences between intrisic primitives, GDE tangent primitives, and GDE-Pair compositions on the hyperbolic geometry as a representative case.

blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en:
Datasets. We evaluate compositional recognition on four datasets spanning varying levels of semantic diversity and attribute-object coupling.
MIT-States [ 10 ] contains 115 attributes paired with 245 objects, yielding 28,175 open-world compositions.
VAW-CZSL [ 31 , 26 ] is substantially larger, with 440 attributes and 541 objects (238,140 candidate compositions) sampled from images with larger scene context.
UT-Zappos [ 38 ] is focused on footwear with 16 material attributes and 12 shoe types, while Clothing16K provides a broader clothing-domain benchmark with greater intra-category variability.
Together, these datasets allow us to study compositionality under both highly diverse semantic settings (MIT-States, VAW-CZSL) and more constrained cases where sample variance is small and attributes are tightly coupled to object identity (UT-Zappos, Clothing16K).
blocks.zh:
数据集. 我们评价四个数据集的构成识别,这些数据集涵盖不同程度的语义多样性和属性-对象结合。
MIT-States [10] 包含115个属性与245个对象对齐,产生28,175个开放世界成分.
VAW-CZSL[31,26]大得多,有440个属性和541个对象(238,140个候选成分)从场景背景较大的图像中取样.
UT-Zappos [38] 以鞋类为主,具有16种物质属性和12种鞋型,而服装16K则提供了更广泛的服装领域基准,且类别内差异较大.
这些数据集共同使我们能够在高度多样化的语义设置(MIT-States,VAW-CZSL)下研究组成性,在样本差异小,属性与对象身份紧密结合(UT-Zappos,Cloat16K)的更受制约的情况下研究组成性.

blocks.en:
Models and baselines. We investigate models operating in Euclidean, spherical, and hyperbolic embedding spaces.
Spherical models include CLIP: ViT-B/16 (GRIT dataset) and ViT-L/14 (OpenAI).
For Euclidean representations, we use DINOv2 with Talk2DINO [ 1 ] bridge to the text embedding of CLIP. This preserve the native Euclidean embeddings of DINOv2 and enables to compute baseline results with CLIP-style text prompts (see Appendix B ).
We also experiment with MERU [ 5 ] and
HyCoCLIP [ 23 ] hyperbolic models.
CLIP-B, MERU-B, and HyCoCLIP-B share the same ViT backbone and are pretrained on the GRIT corpus [ 25 ] , thus allowing to attribute performance differences primarily to the underlying manifold geometry.

blocks.en:
Metrics. We compute the unseen pair accuracy (UPA) that evaluates the generalization to novel attribute-object compositions, and the seen pair accuracy (SPA) that measures the recognition performance on compositions observed during training (we report SPA in Appendix G ).
Models often exhibit a bias toward seen compositions, especially in the open-world setting where all feasible compositions are considered candidate predictions. Evaluating only one regime can provide a misleading picture of overall performance. Hence, as standard practice in OW-CZSL [ 18 ] , we report the best harmonic mean of seen and unseen compositions: HM = 2 ⋅ SPA ⋅ UPA SPA + UPA , \mathrm{HM}=\frac{2\cdot\mathrm{SPA}\cdot\mathrm{UPA}}{\mathrm{SPA}+\mathrm{UPA}}, that penalizes models that perform well on only one subset and therefore captures the ability to maintain strong recognition on both seen and unseen compositions simultaneously.
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 我们计算对新属性-对象成分进行概括评价的隐形配对精度(UPA)和对训练时观察到的成分进行识别的显式配对精度(SPA)(我们在附录G中报告SPA)。
模型往往偏向于所见的成分,特别是在开放世界环境中,所有可行的成分都被视为候选人预测。 仅评价一个制度就可能对整个业绩产生误导。 因此,作为OW-CZSL [18] 的标准做法,我们报告所见和所见组成的最佳谐调平均值:HM = 2 → SPA → UPA SPA + UPA ,\mathrm{HM}=\frac{2\cdot\mathrm{ SPA}\cdot\mathrm{UPA}}{\ → SPA}+\mathrm{UPA}},它惩罚只在一个子集上表现良好的模型,因此能够同时保持对所见和所见组成物的强烈认知。

blocks.en:
In Table 1 we reports the Harmonic Mean (HM) and Unseen Pair Accuracy (UPA) results of the CZSL performance of the considered pretrained models. Across models and datasets, replacing GDE pair composition with primitive-based inference consistently improves both metrics, indicating that explicit pair re-composition is not necessary for compositional generalization.
On MIT-States, GDE primitives improve HM over GDE pairs by +1.53 for CLIP ViT-L/14, +1.66 for DINOv2, +1.89 for CLIP-B, +2.99 for MERU-B, and +3.66 for HyCoCLIP-B.
The gains are often larger for UPA, including +3.85 for MERU-B and +5.04 for HyCoCLIP-B, indicating that primitives specifically strengthen open-world generalization.
Notably, DINOv2 also benefits from primitive decomposition despite weak zero-shot pair prediction performance, improving HM by +1.65 on MIT-States and +0.90 on VAW-CZSL.
As DINOv2 is trained without image-text contrastive supervision, this suggests that compositional semantics intrinsically emerge also from large-scale vision-only self-supervision.
Across geometries, intrinsic primitives provide the most stable formulation, particularly in hyperbolic space, consistently with representing visual concept directly on the embedding manifold rather than through tangent-space approximations.
Overall, primitive representations provide a stronger tool for open-world compositional generalization than explicit pair composition.

在MIT-States上,GDE原始人将HM比GDE对改进为CLIP VIT-L/14的+1.53,DINov2的+1.66,CLIP-B的+1.89,MERU-B的+2.99,HyCoCLIP-B的+3.66.
UPA的增益往往较大,包括MERU-B的+3.85和HyCoCLIP-B的+5.04,这表明原始物特别加强了开放世界的泛化.
值得注意的是,DINOv2也得益于原始分解,尽管零射对预测性能薄弱,在MIT-States和VAW-CZSL上分别提高了HM+1.65和+0.90.
由于DINOv2是在没有图像-文本对比性监督的情况下接受训练的,这说明组成语义的内在性也从大规模视觉只自我监督中出现.

总的来说,原始的表示比显式的对偶组成为开放世界的构成概括提供了更强大的工具.

blocks.en:
Dataset structure affects compositional reasoning. UT-Zappos is a consistent exception to the advantages observed for primitive-based CZSL inference on the broader CZSL datasets.
The dataset covers a narrow semantic domain and its samples have strongly coupled attribute–object relationship, with many attributes appearing across a restricted set of shoe categories (see Figure 6 in the Appendix).
We therefore test whether effectiveness of primitive-based compositional inference depends on the semantic spread of the embedding distribution: we investigate the intrinsic dataset variance and causally link its value to compositional generalization performance.
For embeddings { 𝐱 i } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{x}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} from dataset 𝒟 \mathcal{D} on manifold ℳ \mathcal{M} , we compute the intrinsic variance V ⁡ ( 𝒟 ) = 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N d ℳ 2 ​ ( 𝐱 i , 𝝁 𝒟 ) , V(\mathcal{D})=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}d_{\mathcal{M}}^{2}\left(\mathbf{x}_{i},\bm{\mu}_{\mathcal{D}}\right), (12) where 𝝁 𝒟 \bm{\mu}_{\mathcal{D}} is the Fréchet mean and d ℳ ​ ( ⋅ , ⋅ ) d_{\mathcal{M}}(\cdot,\cdot) is the geodesic distance.
Figure 3 reveals a similar pattern across Euclidean, spherical, and hyperbolic representations: MIT-States, VAW-CZSL, and Clothing16K have substantially greater intrinsic variance than UT-Zappos.
This suggests that primitive decomposition benefits from representations spanning sufficiently diverse semantic contexts, whereas low-variance distributions allow pair representations to exploit stronger dataset-specific attribute-object co-occurrence patterns.

We study the role of intrinsic dataset variance as a causal factor to explain compositional reasoning limitations. We apply a geometry-specific whitening operation (detailed in Appendix E ) to the embeddings of the considered models of the UTZappos dataset, and denote the resulting representations as UTZ-W.
Whitening has the effect of increasing the intrinsic variance of UTZ-W (similarly to that of the broader datasets) compared to that of the original UT-Zappos.
blocks.zh:
我们研究内在数据集差异作为解释组成推理局限性的因果因素的作用. 我们对UTZappos数据集中考虑的模型的嵌入应用一种几何特异性的白化操作(详见附录E),并表示由此而来的表示为UTZ-W.
与原始的UT-Zappos相比,Whitening具有增加UTZ-W(类似于更广泛的数据集)内在差异的作用.

blocks.en: We report CZSL results before and after whitening in Table 2 : the HM and UPA values increase noticeably for both GDE- and intrinsic-primitive compositional inference, achieving comparable or largely superior performance in some cases than pair-based inference.
blocks.zh: 我们报告表2中白化前后的CZSL结果:GDE和内在成份推论的HM值和UPA值都明显增加,在某些情况下比对子推论达到可比或基本优越的性能。

blocks.en: After whitening, intrinsic primitives achieve the highest HM for every model and the highest UPA for four of five models, falling only 0.05 points below the best MERU-B UPA results using pair-based inference. These results provide causal evidence that low intrinsic variance of the dataset (and its embedding distribution) contributes to the original failure mode of compositional inference. UT-Zappos is thus not a failure of primitive inference: its low-variance representation suppresses decomposition effectiveness.
blocks.zh: 白化后,内在原始人利用对偶推论,实现每个模型的最高HM,以及五个模型中四个模型的最高UPA,只比最佳MERU-B UPA结果低0.05分. 这些结果提供了因果证据,表明数据集内在差异不大(及其嵌入分布),助长了最初的构成推论的失败模式. 因此,UT-Zappos并不是原始推论的失败:它的低变异代表抑制了分解效果.

blocks.en:
A key premise of primitive-based inference is that the decomposition isolates object and attribute information into distinct semantic components.
We test this by measuring the statistical dependence between object, attribute, and pair representations using Pearson cross-correlation (CORR) and mutual information (MI). We perform this analysis on the GDE primitives.
The results show that, across datasets and model families, the dependence and mutual information between object and attribute primitive representations is consistently substantially lower than those of either object and pair or attribute and pair representations.
For example, on MIT-States object and attribute primitive CORR remains between 0.444 0.444 and 0.473 0.473 across models, compared to 0.825 0.825 – 0.895 0.895 for object primitive and pair representation, and the MI estimates are 13.0 13.0 versus 119.4 119.4 – 320.7 320.7 .
We observe similar results across the considered CZSL datasets and model representations.
We report full results in Appendix D .

基于原始推论的一个关键前提是分解将对象分离,并将信息属性化为不同的语义成分.
我们通过测量对象、属性以及使用皮尔逊交叉关系(CORR)和相互信息(MI)的对等表示之间的统计依赖性来检验这一点。 我们在GDE原始人身上进行这种分析.
结果表明,在各种数据集和模型家族中,物体和属性原始表示之间的依赖性和相互信息一直大大低于物体和成对或属性和成对表示。
例如,在MIT-States上,对象和属性原始CORR在不同的模型中仍然在0.444 0.444和0.473 0.473之间,而对象原始和对子代表值为0.825 0.895 0.895,而MI的估计值为13.0 13.0对 119.4 119.4 – 320.7 320.7.
我们看到,在考虑的CZSL数据集和模型表述中,也有类似的结果。
我们在附录D中报告全部结果。

blocks.en:
The higher dependence that we consistently observe between the primitive representations and the full pair representation are expected and confirm the disentanglement quality of the factorization that we perform. Object and attribute primitives retain information from the composition from which they are derived, while exhibiting weak dependence on one another.
These results provide evidence that primitive-based decomposition, as we study it, recovers a factorized semantic structure in which object and attribute information is meaningfully separated rather than simply reproducing the original pair representation, and thus providing a solid tool for compositional reasoning.
blocks.zh:
我们一直观察到原始代表与全对代表之间的高度依赖性,这是人们所期望的,并证实了我们所表现的因子化的分解质量。 对象和属性原始人保留其来源的成分中的信息,同时表现出对彼此的微弱依赖.
这些结果提供了证据表明,在我们研究时,原始的分解恢复了一种元素化的语义结构,其中对象和属性信息被有意义地分离,而不是简单地复制原始的对称表示,从而为组成推理提供了坚实的工具.

blocks.en: 5.4 Group Robustness via Primitives
blocks.zh: 5.4 团体通过初级体力

blocks.en: Pre-trained vision-language models achieve strong zero-shot performance under distribution shift, but remain sensitive to spurious correlations and subgroup imbalance [ 40 ] . Existing approaches to group robustness typically rely on group annotations, additional optimization, group-specific prompts, adaptation, or class reweighting [ 30 , 33 , 11 , 7 , 12 , 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 训练有素的视觉语言模型在分配转变下实现了强烈的零镜头性能,但对虚假的关联和分组不平衡仍然敏感[40]. 集团稳健性的现有方法一般依靠集团说明,附加优化,集团特定提示,适应,或类重加权[30,33,11,7,12,32].

blocks.en:
We instead ask whether the compositional structure already encoded in and emerging from pretrained representations can itself be used for robust inference.
The results of the statistical disentanglement indicate that decomposed primitives separate object and attribute semantics, allowing inference to retain information relevant to the object while suppressing attribute directions that may induce spurious correlations. We thus evaluate decomposed primitive for robustness to group bias on Waterbirds [ 30 ] and CelebA [ 16 ] . We do not use group annotations, additional data, or further optimization. Specifically, we classify images using only the object primitives, retaining only the object-score component of Eq. 6 , Eq. 7 and Eq. 11 for zero-shot, intrinsic, and GDE primitives, respectively.
Table 3 shows that this simple inference-time decomposition consistently improves group robustness. Both GDE and intrinsic object primitives improve worst-group accuracy over zero-shot object inference while largely preserving, and in several cases improving, average accuracy. These gains arise without an explicit debiasing objective or fairness supervision: they come solely from isolating semantic structure already present in the pretrained representations. This suggests that compositional factorization is not only useful for interpreting representations, but also provides a practical mechanism for reducing reliance on spurious attributes at inference time.
blocks.zh:
相反,我们询问,已经编码和产生于预先训练过的表述的构成结构本身是否可以用来进行有力的推论。
统计解脱的结果表明,分解的原始物将对象和属性语义分开,允许推论保留与对象有关的信息,同时抑制可能诱发虚假关联的属性方向. 因此,我们评价腐烂的原始 强健性 组合偏向水鸟 [30] 和 CelebA [16]。 我们不使用组说明、附加数据或进一步优化。 具体来说,我们只使用对象原始物对图像进行分类,只保留Eq 6,Eq 7和Eq 11中对象核心成分,分别用于零射,内在,和GDE原始物.
表3显示,这种简单的推论时间分解不断提高组分稳健性. GDE和内在对象原始体都比零射线对象推论提高了最差组的精度,同时在很大程度上保持了平均精度,并有几次提高了平均精度. 这些收益是在没有明确的客观或公平监督的情况下产生的:它们完全来自预先训练过的表述中已经存在的孤立的语义结构。 这表明,组成因素化不仅有助于解释表述,而且为在推断时减少对虚假属性的依赖提供了实用机制。

blocks.en: Intrinsic primitives yield better group robustness in hyperbolic spaces. The group robustness gains are especially pronounced for MERU and HyCoCLIP, where intrinsic object primitives yield large improvements in both average and worst-group accuracy. We conjecture that this advantage is related to the radial organization of semantic abstraction in the hyperbolic space. Intrinsic object primitives lie closer to the origin than compound object–attribute representations, consistent with their encoding broader, less attribute-specific concepts. GDE primitives, by contrast, are obtained through a local linear approximation around the Fréchet mean and can therefore remain more influenced by the local neighborhood structure induced by dominant attribute or background correlations. This provides a plausible geometric explanation for the stronger robustness of intrinsic primitives that lay directly on the manifold. The radial organization of these representations is further explored in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 在双曲空间中,内核原始体产生更好的组固性. 组固性增益对于MERU和HyCoCLIP来说尤为明显,其内在对象原始物在平均和最差组的准确性方面都有很大的改进。 我们推测这种优势与双曲空间中语义抽象的射线组织有关. 与复合对象-属性表示法相比,内在对象原始物更接近起源,符合其编码范围更广,属性特定性较小的概念. 相比之下,GDE原始物是通过Fréchet平均值周围的局部线性近似法获得的,因此可以继续受到由主导属性或背景关联诱导的局部邻里结构的较大影响. 这为直接存在于多面体上的内在原始物更坚固提供了合理的几何解释。 附录H进一步探讨了这些表述的横向组织。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This work establishes primitive decomposition as a unifying principle for compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) across Euclidean, spherical, and hyperbolic vision–language models. By systematically analyzing models with diverse manifold geometries, we demonstrate that compositional structure consistently emerges in pretrained vision embeddings in the form of primitive visual concept representations, which can be directly exploited for compositional zero-shot inference. Crucially, we show that explicit attribute-object pair re-composition is not necessary for CZSL: independently reasoning over attribute and object primitives, with specifically-designed scoring functions, can effectively support compositional open-world generalization.
blocks.zh: 这项工作将原始分解确立为跨越欧几利得、球形和双曲线视觉-语言模型的构成零射学习(CZSL)的统一原则。 通过系统分析各种多面几何的模型,我们表明,组成结构在预先训练的视觉中不断出现,以原始视觉概念表现形式嵌入,可以直接用于组成零射线推论. 关键是,我们显示明确的属性-对象对重组合对于CZSL是不必要的:独立推理相对于属性和对象原始,具有专门设计的评分功能,可以有效支持成分开放-世界概括.

blocks.en:
We demonstrate primitives as a novel paradigm for CZSL inference with results being consistent for the tangent space GDE primitives and intrinsic primitives.
Across experiments, GDE primitives provide robust and transferable primitive representations, consistently outperforming pair-based compositions for open-world CZSL while remaining simple and geometry-agnostic. Intrinsic primitives offer a complementary, geometry-aware refinement, particularly effective in hyperbolic spaces, where operating directly on the manifold improves stability by avoiding local linearization errors.
We further demonstrate benefits of primitive-based inference in group robustness tasks, where object-primitive representations allow to perform unbiased inference without model re-training, avoiding spurious correlations induced by attribute characteristics.
blocks.zh:
我们展示原始物作为CZSL推论的一种新范式,其结果与实际空间GDE原始物和内在原始物一致。
在整个实验中,GDE原始人提供了坚固和可转移的原始表示,在保持简单和几何-不可知性的同时,为开放世界的CZSL提供一贯优于性能的对称组成. 内源性原始物提供了一种互补的,几何感知的改进,在双曲空间中特别有效,在多面上直接运行通过避免局部线性化错误来提高稳定性.
我们进一步展示了原始推论在群体坚固性任务中的好处,即对象原始表达允许在没有模型再训练的情况下进行无偏见的推论,避免属性特征诱导的虚假关联.

blocks.en: Finally, this work provides the first comprehensive and unified view of primitive-based CZSL, demonstrating it as an emerging property of existing pretrained models.
blocks.zh: 最后,这部作品为原始的CZSL提供了第一个全面和统一的视角,展示了它作为现有预训模型的新兴属性.

blocks.en: Appendix D GDE Primitive Concept Separation
blocks.zh: 附录D GDE 初步概念分离

blocks.en:
To assess whether the GDE primitives capture concept structure that is separable in the model’s embedding space, we measure the statistical dependence between each pair of primitives using two complementary estimators: the Pearson cross correlation (CORR), and a canonical correlation estimator of mutual information (MI) computed with the bench-mi mutual information package [ 4 ] .
CORR captures linear alignment between two sets of vectors, while MI additionally captures non-linear dependence structure that a purely linear estimator would miss.
We report both for the three primitive pairings: object-attribute, object-pair, and attribute-pair.
Our analysis is limited to GDE primitives.
blocks.zh:
为了评估GDE原始人是否捕捉在模型嵌入空间中可分离的概念结构,我们用两个互补的估算器来测量每对原始人之间的统计依赖性:皮尔逊交叉相关性(CORR),以及用长凳-米相互信息包计算出来的相互信息的犬类关联估计器[4].
CORR捕捉两组矢量之间的线性对齐,而MI额外捕捉纯线性估计器会错过的非线性依赖结构.
我们同时报告三个原始的配对:对象属性、对象坑和属性坑。
我们的分析仅限于GDE原始人.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Cross Correlation and Mutual Information estimates between the GDE primitives and the model embedding. Since GDE primtives live in euclidean space, usual statistics calculation methods apply.
blocks.zh: 表5:GDE原始人与模型嵌入物之间的交叉关联和相互信息估计. 由于GDE pritives生活在euclide空间,通常的统计计算方法适用.

blocks.en:
Across datasets and models, in Table 5 , we observe trends consistent with our expectations: the object-attribute pairing is consistently the lowest correlated and carries the least mutual information relative to object-pair and attribute-pair.
This suggests that object and attribute representations are comparatively more disentangled from one another, whereas information about objects and attributes is each more entangled with pairwise (relational) structure than with each other.
blocks.zh:
在整个数据集和模型中,我们在表5中观察到了与我们的期望相一致的趋势:对象属性配对始终是最低的关联性,而且与对象属性属性对应的相互信息最少。
这表明对象和属性的表示相对地更相互分离,而关于对象和属性的信息则各自与对偶(关系)结构的纠缠比彼此更为紧密.

blocks.en:
We also note that object-pair estimates are consistently higher than attribute-pair estimates across datasets and models.
This points to embeddings being generally more aligned with object-level information than with attribute-level information, and suggests attribute-awareness may be an area where current embeddings are comparatively weaker, a direction that could benefit from further study.
blocks.zh:
我们还注意到,各数据集和模型的物体平面估计一直高于属性平面估计。
这表明嵌入一般比属性级信息更符合对象级信息,并表明属性意识可能是当前嵌入相对较弱的领域,这个方向可以从进一步研究中受益.

For spherical and hyperbolic features, we instead perform whitening in a tangent space, following the general principle of Principal Geodesic Analysis (PGA) [ 6 ] .

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
A spherical-specific restriction arises from the cut locus.
For the unit sphere, the logarithmic representation around 𝝁 \bm{\mu} is unique only for tangent vectors with norm smaller than π \pi .
Arbitrarily rescaling a tangent vector beyond this radius causes the exponential map to wrap around the sphere.
Distinct tangent vectors can then map to the same or nearby spherical locations, which may destroy semantic information encoded by their relative positions. We therefore constrain the norm of the projected tangent vector to remain within the injectivity radius with rescaling. This follows the same general tangent-space construction used in spherical PCA methods spherepc [ 15 ] .

区分的正切矢量然后可以映射到相同或附近的球形位置,这可能会破坏由相对位置编码的语义信息. 因此,我们限制预测正切矢量的规范,使其保持在注射半径以内,并进行伸缩。 这与球形五氯苯甲醚方法中所用的一般正切-空间构造相同。

blocks.en: Appendix H Hierarchy of Hyperbolic Intrinsic Primitives
blocks.zh: 附录H 超曲面内置先导的等级

blocks.en: Hyperbolic embeddings encode hierarchy through radial distance from the origin, where larger radii correspond to more specific concepts. Driven by the strong group robustness results, and to further deepen the analysis of the properties of the intrinsic primitives, we examine the distributions of the radius of the representations of attributes, objects, and attribute-object compositions on the manifold of hyperbolic models.
blocks.zh: 超曲面嵌入通过离起源的射线距离来编码层次,其中较大的射线对应更具体的概念. 在强群强性结果的推动下,为了进一步深化对内在原始物属性的分析,我们考察了在双曲模型的多重上对属性,对象,和属性-对象组成的半径的分布.

blocks.en: We plot the computed distributions for HyCoCLIP in Figure 4 and for MERU in Figure 5 for the considered datasets. The embeddings of attribute-object compositions consistently occupy larger radii than their constituent primitives, consistently with the expected semantic hierarchy in hyperbolic spaces: compositions such as blue car are more specific than either primitives alone.
blocks.zh: 我们在图4中绘制了HyCoCLIP的计算分布图,在图5中绘制了被考虑的数据集的MERU的计算分布图。 属性-对象成分的嵌入体一直占据比其构成原始体更大的弧度,与双曲空间中预期的语义等级一致:蓝车等成分比任何一个原始体都更具体.

blocks.en: For MIT-States, VAW-CZSL, UT-Zappos, and Clothing16K, attribute primitives tend to lie closer to the origin and thus represent more general concepts, shared across several objects. Object primitives instead occupy deeper regions of the hierarchy, configuring as slightly more specific and complex semantic concepts in the considered datasets. In contrast, Waterbirds and CelebA data shows the opposite trend, with attributes occupying larger radii than objects. This suggests that attributes (e.g., backgrounds in Waterbirds or facial characteristics in CelebA) add complexity and further specifications to the object concepts in the dataset, possibly inducing biases and dominating the semantic structure of the data. The results of this analysis align with those achieved for group robustness tests where intrinsic primitives show exceptional de-biasing performance for hyperbolic models: the use of object primitives allows to disentangle the complexity induced by the attributes that cause bias and spurious correlations arising in the zero-shot predictions.
blocks.zh: 对于MIT-States,VAW-CZSL,UT-Zappos,以及Clothes16K来说,属性原始人往往更接近起源,因此代表了更普遍的概念,在多个对象之间共享. 对象原始人反而占据了更深层次的区域,在被考虑的数据集中将语义概念配置为略为具体和复杂的. 相比之下,Waterbirds和CelebA的数据显示了相反的趋势,其属性占据的弧度大于物体. 这表明属性(如水鸟的背景或CelebA中的面部特征)为数据集中的对象概念增加了复杂性和进一步规格,可能诱发偏差,并支配数据语义结构. 本分析的结果与群体强性测试所实现的结果一致,这些测试的内在原始物表现出超曲面模型的异常的去偏斜性能:使用对象原始物可以分解零射线预测中产生的导致偏差和假相关性的属性所引发的复杂性.

blocks.en:
From a general perspective, these observations support the effectiveness of intrinsic primitive inference.
Primitive embeddings occupy denser and better-covered regions of the representation space, whereas compositions correspond to deeper and sparser concepts. By decomposing representations into primitives rather than relying on locally estimated GDE primitives, intrinsic primitive means remain closer to the training distribution and better capture the dominant semantic structure of the dataset. This leads to more stable compositional representations and improved robustness under distribution shifts.
blocks.zh:
从一般的角度来看,这些观察支持内在原始推论的有效性.
原始嵌入物占据了代表空间较密集和覆盖较好的区域,而构成则与较深和较少的概念相对应。 通过将代表物分解为原始物,而不是依靠当地估计的GDE原始物,内在原始手段仍然更接近于训练分布,更好地捕捉数据集的主要语义结构. 这导致在分配的转变下,组成代表性更加稳定,稳健性得到提高。

blocks.en: Overall, most datasets exhibit substantial variation in both attributes and objects, reflecting the combinatorial nature of the task. In particular, Clothing16K contains a broad range of clothing categories and attributes, including different garment types, textures, and visual appearances, as well as a wider variety of poses and viewpoints. This results in higher visual diversity and more challenging compositional generalization settings.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,大多数数据集在属性和对象上都表现出很大差异,反映了任务的组合性质. 特别是服装16K包含广泛的服装类别和属性,包括不同的服装类型,纹理,视觉外观,以及更广泛的姿势和观点. 这导致了更高的视觉多样性和更具挑战性的构成概括设置.

blocks.en: In contrast, UT-Zappos is considerably more constrained, consisting exclusively of footwear categories. Moreover, the visual presentation of objects in this dataset tends to be relatively consistent, with limited variation in pose and viewpoint. This reduced geometric and semantic diversity aligns with our observation of lower compositional variability and helps explain its comparatively different behavior in our results.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,UT-Zappos受到更大的制约,完全由鞋类组成。 此外,本数据集对物体的直观呈现往往相对一致,在姿势和视角上差异有限. 这种几何和语义多样性的减少符合我们对较低的组成变化的观察,并有助于解释它在我们的结果中相对不同的行为。
